name: git-worktree
description: Git worktree MCP server for isolated parallel agent squads (Antipattern #80 prevention)

tools.name: create_worktree
tools.description: Create an isolated git worktree on a new branch for a specific agent/task. Returns the worktree path.

tools.name: list_worktrees
tools.description: List all active worktrees and their branches.

tools.name: merge_worktree
tools.description: Merge a worktree branch back to target branch. Ordered by blast radius (Best Practice #18).

params.blastRadius: enum: low|medium|high (required, used for merge ordering)

tools.name: remove_worktree
tools.description: Remove a worktree after successful merge. Refuses if uncommitted changes exist.

tools.name: diff_worktree
tools.description: Get diff of a worktree against its base branch.

invariants: Agents MUST operate in their own worktree; never on the main worktree.
Merges are ordered low → medium → high blast radius.
Uncommitted changes block worktree removal unless force=true (audited).
